headline: Loss narrows sequentially, swings from a year-ago profit
summary_short: J&V Energy Technology reported a Q2 FY2026 EPS loss of NT$0.90, narrower than the NT$0.99 loss posted last quarter but a reversal from a NT$3.83 per-share profit a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS was -NT$0.90, a narrower per-share loss than the -NT$0.99 posted last quarter, but a swing from the NT$3.83 profit reported a year earlier. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
